examples.en: He was a great racing driver.
examples.zh: 他是一位伟大的赛车手。

examples.en: The driver set up a new world record.
examples.zh: 这位车手创造了一项新的世界纪录。

examples.en: He set up a world record in 1935.
examples.zh: 他于1935年创造了一项世界纪录。

examples.en: He drove at a speed of over 300 miles per hour.
examples.zh: 他以每小时300多英里的速度驾驶。

examples.en: The salt flats are miles long.
The car was specially built for him.
examples.zh: 这辆汽车是专门为他制造的。

examples.en: The car was over thirty feet in length.
A tyre burst during the first run.
examples.zh: 第一次行驶中一个轮胎爆了。

examples.en: After his attempt, he was disappointed.
He was disappointed to learn the truth.
His average speed was 301 miles per hour.
A mistake had been made in the record.

words.meaning: n. 马尔科姆·坎贝尔（人名）

examples.en: Malcolm Campbell was a famous racing driver.
examples.zh: 马尔科姆·坎贝尔是一位著名的赛车手。

examples.en: Bluebird was the name of the car.

words.meaning: n. 博纳维尔盐滩（地名）

examples.en: Bonneville Salt Flats is in Utah.
examples.zh: 博纳维尔盐滩位于犹他州。

sentences.en: Bluebird, the car he was driving, had been specially built for him.
sentences.zh: 他驾驶的'蓝鸟'汽车是专门为他制造的。

sentences.en: It was over thirty feet in length and had a 2,500-horsepower engine.
sentences.zh: 它长30多英尺，配有一台2500马力的发动机。

sentences.en: Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour, but a tyre burst during the first run.
sentences.zh: 坎贝尔的时速超过了304英里，但在第一次行驶中一个轮胎爆了。

sentences.en: A few days later, he was told that a mistake had been made.
sentences.zh: 几天后，有人告诉他出了个差错。

sentences.en: His average speed had been 301 miles per hour.

article.en: Sir Malcolm Campbell, the great racing driver, was the first man to drive at over 300 miles per hour.
article.zh: 伟大的赛车手马尔科姆·坎贝尔爵士是第一个驾车时速超过300英里的人。

article.en: He set up a new world record in September 1935 at Bonneville Salt Flats, Utah.
article.zh: 1935年9月，他在犹他州的博纳维尔盐滩创造了一项新的世界纪录。

article.en: Bluebird, the car he was driving, had been specially built for him.
article.zh: 他驾驶的'蓝鸟'汽车是专门为他制造的。

article.en: It was over thirty feet in length and had a 2,500-horsepower engine.
article.zh: 它长30多英尺，配有一台2500马力的发动机。

article.en: Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour, but a tyre burst during the first run.
article.zh: 坎贝尔的时速超过了304英里，但在第一次行驶中一个轮胎爆了。

article.en: After his attempt, Campbell was disappointed to learn that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
article.zh: 尝试结束后，坎贝尔失望地得知他的平均时速是299英里。

article.en: A few days later, he was told that a mistake had been made.
article.zh: 几天后，有人告诉他出了个差错。

article.en: His average speed had been 301 miles per hour.
Since that time, racing drivers have reached speeds of over 600 miles an hour.
article.zh: 自那时以来，赛车手们已经达到了每小时600多英里的速度。
